original_code: All Python scripts in this bundle were newly authored for the research; no upstream source schedules or implementation code were executed.

pure_data.description: Pinned U15 transition data supplied from the prior matrix-semigroup construction; A..O correspond to u1..u15, 0 is blank c, 1 is b; sole undefined transition J1.

primary_sources.used: Ordinary lattice primitive construction and lazy-CA qualitative reduction; literal coordinates, compressed full circuit, periodic router and quantitative proofs are provided here.

primary_sources.title: Turlough Neary and Damien Woods, Four Small Universal Turing Machines
primary_sources.used: Fixed U15 universality and effective arbitrary-program-to-finite-tape input encoding remain imported. That earlier input encoder is not implemented here.

repository_obligation.description: Part XVI and manuscript19 already supply general odometer certificates but leave verified universal periodic input loading unimplemented.

scope: Fixed U15 finite binary tape pair to ordinary Z^3 stable periodic background plus finite nonnegative additions, with proof of global finite activity iff halting and explicit quadratic active-prism bound. Diophantine certificate composition is separate.
